$comment: Schema for execution-state.json — written by alfred-build during execution. Lives in alfred-plans/<slug>/execution-state.json. Used for progress tracking, resumption, and final reporting.

status.notes: running = in progress. complete = all steps done. stopped = safe stop (resumable). failed = unrecoverable.

overall_status.notes: Set at Step 7 (full-page verification). null during build.

safety.original_page_id: integer | null — ID of live page if duplicated
safety.working_page_id: integer | null — ID of draft/duplicate being built
safety.is_duplicate: boolean — true if working on a copy of an existing page
safety.force_live: boolean — true if --force-live flag was used

asset_manifest.$comment: Map of plan asset_id → resolution result

img-001.stock_query: string | null — query used if stock_substituted

widget_map.$comment: Map of canonical block type → resolved Elementor widget name for this build
widget_map.heading: heading

sections.$comment: Per-section execution state. Key = section_id from plan.

sec-001.status: pending | building | built | verified | repair-failed | skipped
sec-001.elementor_section_id: string | null — actual Elementor element ID after injection

stop_reason: string | null — set when status is 'stopped' or 'failed'
